bullets.text: Robotaxis Arriving in London - **Uber** and **Lyft** will test **Baidu's** robotaxis in London starting 2026.
ChatGPT's Year-End Review - **OpenAI** launches a personalized recap feature similar to **Spotify Wrapped**.
AI Browsers Vulnerable to Attacks - **OpenAI** warns that prompt injection attacks may persist in AI browsers.
Alphabet Acquires Intersect Power - **Alphabet** buys **Intersect Power** for $4.75 billion to enhance energy capacity.
Tech Layoffs Continue in 2025 - Over 22,000 tech workers have been laid off this year amid ongoing cutbacks.
